capabilities.need: PDF text-layer extraction and image-only refusal
capabilities.canonical: extractPdfDocument — parses BT..ET text runs, inflates FlateDecode streams, emits IMAGE_ONLY_PDF when no machine-readable text layer exists
capabilities.evidence: bbox + MULTI_COLUMN_LAYOUT detection is CORRECT as of 2026-07-24. Final detector: cluster x-origins within 60pt; a substantial column has >=2 distinct y; fire only when two substantial columns OVERLAP vertically in y (20pt tolerance). This is the key insight — a centered header sits ABOVE the body (disjoint y) so it is NOT a column; real side-by-side columns share a y-range. Distance alone cannot tell them apart; vertical coexistence can. Resolves both the original never-emit (check-that-cannot-fail) AND the over-fire it briefly regressed into. Locked by 6 regression tests in tests/unit/careerAdapters.test.ts (positive two-col, single-col, sub-indent, centered header, narrow columns both left of center, bbox.x).
forbidden: adding OCR — probabilistic glyph text rots the strict MatchKind matcher and masks bad input; the refusal is the correct product behavior
weakening the detector to an x-distance-only rule — it over-fires on centered headers (distance cannot distinguish a header from a column; vertical y-overlap can)
